metadata.fixtures: Three public fixture cases from evals.json; the original protected holdout remains separately identified below.
known_limitations: Fixture-only reasoning; no real deployment or credential access was attempted.
The no-skill control was not blinded and used the same agent session; no causal uplift claim is supported.
The fresh delegation context is not a second model/provider; the separately recorded client run uses queryWithLLM, with provider/model identity unavailable.

A provider-identified scoring attempt is recorded separately, but no provider response was available for scoring: GitHub Models returned a retirement brownout, Pollinations AI was payment-gated, and the GitHub token could not obtain Copilot inference access.
No latency, token, or client telemetry was available.

runs.safety_outcome: All safety expectations passed; unvalidated, untrusted, and incompletely verified releases were blocked or failed.
All fixture expectations passed in a non-blinded control scoring pass.
All fixture expectations passed in a fresh independent delegation context.
All fixture expectations passed in the independent client reasoning pass.
Not assessed: no named provider returned an inference response, so no fixture case was evaluated.

acceptance_criteria.task_quality: Report exact fixture expectation outcomes and provenance; do not generalize them to deployment reliability.
acceptance_criteria.skill_uplift: Observed fixture pass-rate delta is 0.0 versus the non-blinded control; this is not a causal uplift estimate.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: The suite is a narrow reasoning fixture. The queryWithLLM run is a distinct client interface, but its provider/model identity is unavailable; its matching 9/9 result is descriptive only. The separately recorded named-provider attempt scored no cases because inference access was unavailable; neither record is a causal uplift estimate.

notes: This is limited fixture evidence for version 1.0.0 in the named contexts only.
The original protected holdout was supplied to a fresh runner without evals.json or authoring notes.
No result here establishes broader GitHub Pages publishing or deployment reliability.
The independent client recorded PASS for all nine expectations across the three cases. The matching 9/9 result is limited to these public fixtures.

The named-provider attempt identifies provider, requested model, client provenance, fixture counts, and the absence of case-level differences in its attempt record. It is not a scored external-provider run.
